notes.title: Pirates vs. Ninjas Fest
notes.content:
[h2]Hey, [b]everybody[/b]! [/h2]

Long time no see.

We are taking part in the [b]Pirates vs Ninjas fest[/b], where you can try out our demo if you haven't tried it yet. 
We will update the page soon with a new trailer and new screenshots. 
There are tons of changes! We've updated the visuals, added additional quests and a lot of other little things

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/2f615ba1ac8a1a2a16e2cb609582eba88fe9f52d.png[/img]

Now we are polishing the game and doing localization, so we won't have long to wait.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Steam Fest results
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/1ec41be3ff45208d94a8f4253ac54d26b70faa0f.png[/img]

[h2]Hi all![/h2]

[h3]it's time to sum up the results of Steam Fest![/h3]

I thank Steam from the bottom of my heart for the opportunity to show my game to so many gamers. 
A huge thanks to the people who came to the streams and added the game to their wishlist.
A special thanks to the people who took the survey (which means they made it to the end) and left their feedback. 
I've read absolutely all of the feedback and suggestions and will definitely consider them.
Here are some planned changes:

- [i][b]Main character design[/b][/i]. 
   It was noticed that the character seems faded, I will work on this.
- [i][b]Balance existing locations, enemies and bosses[/b][/i].
- [i][b]All sorts of QOL additions[/b][/i]. 
   Mostly visual cues to let the player know what they are required to do.
- [i][b]Sections on the boat[/b][/i]. 
   Shorter in time, but more intense in action.

[h2][b]Thank you very much once again![/b][/h2] 

Stay tuned.

notes.title: DEVLOG #3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/489b731903f2210cdc3fe53ea5224660bfac7841.png[/img]

[h2][b]Greetings![/b][/h2]

[i]In this devlog we'd like to talk about a pretty big gameplay update when playing as a possessed.
[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/434dd0194908937ea9221e5d05e486c8e86fa4d4.gif[/img]

[i]Old and slow attack ːsteamthumbsdownː[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/7001e0fcbf087a73e45afa82ae60dfe9f4adcd95.gif[/img]

[i]New fast and beautiful[/i] ːsteamthumbsupː

[h3] [b]We got rid of damage on touch[/b].[/h3]
The gameplay felt clunky. Since the game has the ability to move around a little when you hit it, sometimes you could accidentally bump into an opponent and take damage. Now in these sections of the game, damage will only come from enemies' weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/c0ea2c57732121550db4581d1d40cbf73840fa41.gif[/img]

This may be in contrast to the gameplay for the human-shaped character, where the damage on touch is left unchanged, but in the initial stages of the game there will be a story tutorial. There, these differences will be explained story-wise and shown through gameplay.

[h3]We also increased the [b]attack speed[/b] of the hero and introduced [b]finishing moves[/b].[/h3]

They will need to be unlocked in the store for [b]Dark Essence[/b] currency. 

[h3] A [b]rating system[/b] has also been added [/h3]
If the player will alternate finishing blows with special abilities - the rating will increase. Depending on your rating, you will receive a different amount of Dark Essence when killing enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/2079b90a48c7102201b1b80e41ea12dd177fd32c.gif[/img]

That's all for now. Thank you so much for staying with us! See you around!

notes.title: DevLog #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/489b731903f2210cdc3fe53ea5224660bfac7841.png[/img]

[h1]Hello, everyone! [/h1]
This is the second devlog in which I want to talk about mistakes. 
It's not uncommon for players to die in the same place several times. Especially frustrating when you can not constantly save, and the nearest checkpoint is very far away. And, you have to run through the easy parts of the level over and over again, only to eventually lose your life again on the difficult for the player fragment and start all over again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/cb53be6ac685d6723cf8313d71000deec282a312.gif[/img]

To solve this problem, I put magic gates at each checkpoint. They work like this: if a player dies more than once in a certain part of the level (in some situations, once is enough), he will see a blue or green glow over his character. After that, you can use the gate to teleport to that room. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/94ed5eb9e1e5a8bcfedf67a76d8262342646a8b5.gif[/img]

What does this solve ?
1. Players who aren't interested in running through the same boring sections dozens of times will be able to concentrate at once on the rooms that cause them difficulty and save time (and nerves)
2. Players who want to collect all the treasures, and will be able to do without the gate, because all the good collected between the last checkpoint and the death of the hero, lost.

Thank you all for your attention!
